hero.welcome:
Everything a Movve member needs —
in one place.
hero.subtitle: Track your performance, access exclusive benefits, and evolve your strategy with education and practical tools.

createAccount.title: Create account & verify identity
createAccount.desc1: Create your profile and confirm email/phone.
createAccount.desc2: Send document and selfie for verification.
createAccount.desc3: Wait for KYC approval (you will be notified).

protectAccount.title: Protect your account
protectAccount.desc2: Set transaction PIN and review active sessions.
protectAccount.desc3: Save your recovery phrase/backup in a secure location.

connectWallet.title: Connect Wallet & add balance
connectWallet.desc1: Generate/copy your USDT address (TRC20) within Movve.
connectWallet.desc2: Transfer from your wallet or exchange to this address.
connectWallet.desc3: Track on-chain status and credit in your area.

activateProducts.title: Activate products & monitor
activateProducts.desc1: Movve Wallet: organize assets, activate staking when available.
activateProducts.desc2: Movve A.I: enable automated strategies according to your profile.
activateProducts.desc3: Movve Pay: generate virtual card and use QR for payments.
